answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one sparrow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The tundra report makes public the merge explicitly at each haven. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 127 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 251 times the capital for one share. The per-identity price is 108 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
